items.title: 67802_Charles Mingus oral history interview
items.q: And Max Roach was cussing out his bass player. ... Joe Benjamin.

ctx.x: Calling him faggot. Joe Benjamin. Very loud. And I looked at Duke and Duke looked at me and he had the greatest conversation with the eyes. Because he knew I was about to kill Max. And he was saying, no, don't do it.
Any conversation you can remember, aside from the one in the book, in words?
